user_question: Using the OKLO short thesis as of its initiation date, should this have been actionable, watch, research, or do_nothing?

input_refs.description: Summary of the Oklo Inc short-thesis presentation dated 2025-11-01.
Historical OKLO price-action snapshot through the 2025-10-31 close: close, moving averages, ROC, relative underperformance, and drawdown from all-time high.
Portfolio context: OKLO was a new short position as of thesis initiation.
Initiation rationale: short thesis plus stock starting to decline from all-time high.

assumptions: This draft case uses the OKLO source-document summary, human-provided price action, portfolio context, and initiation notes.
The short thesis was initiated on 2025-11-01. Because that date was a Saturday, price action uses the most recent market close, 2025-10-31.
Context says OKLO was a new short initiated because of the thesis and because the stock had started to decline from its all-time high.

Portfolio conviction input says OKLO would have been conviction 3 at initiation, implying -6% raw target weight under portfolio_sizer.py; confirmation would raise conviction to 5, implying -10% raw target weight.
No exact executed initial size, borrow availability/cost, short interest, option skew, or full portfolio exposure input has been selected yet.

gold_output.simple_thesis: Short OKLO because the stock priced in an AI/nuclear SMR dream despite no revenue, no reactor license, no binding power contracts, no secured HALEU supply, and early signs that the market was starting to reject the story.
gold_output.embedded_macro_exposure: Short speculative AI infrastructure enthusiasm, high-beta unprofitable growth, nuclear/SMR policy optimism, and easy-money risk appetite.

mispricing.consensus_view: The market was valuing OKLO as a major future supplier of nuclear power for AI/data-center demand.
mispricing.variant_view: OKLO's commercial path was far less certain than the valuation implied because the company lacked revenue, a reactor operating license, binding customer contracts, secured HALEU fuel, and a proven prototype.
mispricing.pricing_evidence: The source presentation cites a nearly $19.6B market capitalization, roughly $20B valuation, P/B above 25x, and a $132.77 stock price despite being pre-revenue.
mispricing.why_consensus_is_wrong: Consensus appeared to capitalize a distant nuclear/AI story as if execution, regulation, fuel supply, financing, and customer conversion were already solved.

catalyst_or_reason_now.event_or_condition: The stock had started to break from peak enthusiasm while public scrutiny of the story increased.
catalyst_or_reason_now.why_now: The short was initiated after the thesis identified severe commercial/regulatory gaps and price action showed initial confirmation: OKLO was down about 23.76% from its all-time high and underperforming the Russell 2000.
source_evidence: docs/decision_quality_evals/inputs/oklo_source_document_2025-11-01.json: no revenue, no operating license, no binding power contracts, and roughly $20B valuation
docs/decision_quality_evals/inputs/oklo_price_action_2025-10-31.json: down about 23.76% from all-time high and underperforming Russell 2000
docs/decision_quality_evals/inputs/oklo_initiation_notes_2025-11-01.json: initiated because of thesis plus stock starting to decline

invalidation.observable: OKLO demonstrates real commercial/regulatory progress or the short fails its near-term price-action test.
invalidation.metric_or_event: Binding power contracts, NRC licensing progress, secured HALEU supply, credible financing for deployment, prototype/deployment milestones, price rising from initiation, and whether price breaks below the highest selected moving average.
invalidation.threshold: Force review or cover if OKLO rises 10% from the $132.77 initiation reference price, fails to break below the highest selected moving average within one month, or announces material legally binding customer contracts, credible NRC/license milestones, secured HALEU supply, and credible financing. In this setup the highest selected moving average was the 100D SMA at $90.64.
invalidation.timeframe: One month for the price-action invalidation; ongoing for licensing, fuel, financing, and contract milestones.
invalidation.implication: The market may continue funding the story, the commercialization path may be improving faster than expected, or short timing may be too early.

evidence_for.claim: The valuation was extreme relative to operating reality.
evidence_for.support: The source document says OKLO had no revenue but traded at almost $19.6B-$20B market capitalization and P/B above 25x.

evidence_for.claim: The company lacked key commercialization requirements.
evidence_for.support: The source document says OKLO had no license to operate reactors, no legally binding contracts to supply power, no secured long-term HALEU supply, and no smaller-scale or non-nuclear prototype.

evidence_for.claim: Regulatory history was a real obstacle.
evidence_for.support: The source document says the NRC previously rejected a combined operating and construction license application.

evidence_for.claim: Price action gave initial short confirmation.
evidence_for.support: The price-action input says OKLO was down about 23.76% from its all-time high and underperformed the Russell 2000.

evidence_against.claim: The stock was still in a powerful longer-term uptrend.
evidence_against.support: OKLO remained above all selected moving averages and still had 3-month ROC of 73.76% and 12-month ROC of 434.50%, increasing squeeze and timing risk for a short.
The source document itself notes the short could fail if investor appetite for AI turned into irrational exuberance or if easy money returned.

evidence_against.claim: Shorts have asymmetric loss and borrow/squeeze risk.
evidence_against.support: The selected inputs do not include borrow cost, short interest, option skew, or exact liquidity constraints, so sizing cannot be inferred aggressively.

price_action_read.observed_behavior: OKLO closed at $132.77 on 2025-10-31, above all provided moving averages, with 1-month ROC of 3.08%, 3-month ROC of 73.76%, and 12-month ROC of 434.50%; however, it had underperformed the Russell 2000 and was down about 23.76% from its all-time high.
price_action_read.interpretation: For a short, this is early reversal confirmation after a speculative blowoff, not a completed downtrend. The stock remained technically extended, but the first break from peak enthusiasm supported initiating a controlled short.

actionability.reason: The setup had a clear short thesis, extreme valuation, concrete commercial/regulatory gaps, and initial price confirmation from a large drawdown and relative underperformance.
missing_inputs: Full portfolio exposure to high-beta AI/speculative growth

expression.follow_on: Press only after further price confirmation and no offsetting commercial/regulatory progress.

conviction.upgrade_condition: Short confirmation raises conviction to 5, which maps to a -10% raw target weight.

gold_output.confidence_reason: Moderately high because thesis quality and first price confirmation aligned; capped because the stock remained above major moving averages after a huge 12-month advance and because borrow/squeeze/liquidity inputs are missing.

sizing_context.starting_size: Conviction 3 at initiation maps to a -6% raw target weight under portfolio_sizer.py.
sizing_context.add_conditions: If the short confirms, raise to conviction 5, which maps to a -10% raw target weight, subject to borrow, liquidity, and squeeze constraints.
sizing_context.liquidity_constraints: No ADV, borrow, or exit-cost input selected; do not infer maximum short size from this case.
sizing_context.portfolio_constraints: No full portfolio exposure input selected; final size should account for existing high-beta AI, speculative growth, nuclear/energy, and short-book exposures.

sizing_delta.condition: Initial conviction 3 short; press toward -10% only after price confirmation and borrow/liquidity review.

trade_after_trade.if_right: If the stock continues to decline and the company fails to produce binding commercial/regulatory progress, press only after confirming borrow/liquidity and price trend continuation.
trade_after_trade.if_wrong: If OKLO rises 10%, fails to break below the 100D SMA within one month, or announces credible licensing/contracts/fuel/financing progress, cover or reduce rather than treating the move as only a squeeze.
trade_after_trade.next_review_trigger: Review on any NRC/licensing update, binding customer contract, HALEU/funding announcement, borrow deterioration, a 10% adverse move, or failure to break below the 100D SMA within one month.

human_notes: Review case. Gold output reflects an actionable short at conviction 3, rising to conviction 5 if confirmed.
